A1: All rule groups referring to unobserved characters become MISMATCH. This formalizes manuscript A1; it is not a claim that literal ABSENT is a valid state of every character. nObserved remains the actual observed count.
A4: Strict conjunction: all mapped character groups must be observed and supported for MATCH; any observed mismatch still takes precedence
A5: PROBABLE test precedes equal-score tie test
A6: PROBABLE test additionally requires margin at least 3; no runner-up means infinite margin
A7: Divide score by total positive rule weight with non-neutral verdict; preserve released confidence thresholds, which therefore change scale relative to normalized scores
evaluation: 104 paths from the same KB; internal consistency only. Acc@k uses expected uniform score-tie breaking; abstentions count as errors. Table XIV shared-rank counts are also supplied separately.
